introduce: Sit upright with your back straight and feet flat on the floor. Bend your knees at 90 degrees with your feet hip-width apart. Put your hands beside your ears.\n\nRotate your body gently and slowly. This stretches your back and hips.
name: CHAIR TORSO TWIST

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Please rotate your body gently and slowly.
Your toes and knees should always face forward.
Make sure your abs muscles are engaged.
Please relax your shoulders.
This exercise stretches your back and hips.

introduce: Sit on a chair with your legs hip-with apart and your feet flat on the floor. Interlock your fingers and turn your palms upwards. \n\nStretch your arms overhead. Exhale, push your belly and chest forward and your chin up. Hold this position for a few breaths.
name: CHAIR BACKBEND

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Engage your core muscles.
Breathe in deeply and breathe out completely.
This exercise stretches your upper body.

introduce:
Sit on a chair with your legs hip-with apart and your feet flat on the floor.

Take a deep breath and as you exhale, slowly curl your chin to your chest, draw your lower belly in and round your back. 

Fold your body and press your entire palms on the floor. With every exhalation, move your chest and shoulders away from your thighs. Hold this position for a few breaths.
name: CHAIR CHILD'S POSE

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Engage your core muscles.
Breathe in deeply and breathe out completely.
This pose helps to release tightness in your neck, shoulders, lower back, and hips.

introduce:
Sit on a chair with your legs wide apart and your toes pointing outward. 

Make sure your knees are aligned with your ankles, pointing in the same direction as your toes and forming a 90-degree angle.

Roll your shoulders back and draw your navel slightly in. Inhale, bring your hands on your knees, and as you exhale, bend forwards until your back is parallel to the floor.

Exhale, twist your body to the left, bringing your left shoulder back and your right shoulder forward. 

Take your gaze to your left shoulder. Stay for a few breaths. Return and repeat with the other side.
name: CHAIR REVOLVED GODDESS

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Engage your core muscles.
Keep your breathing soft and deep.
Make sure your knees are aligned with your ankles.

introduce:
Sit on a chair with your legs a little wider than hip-with apart. Let your arms hang naturally at the sides of your body. 

Release your legs and windshield wiper your legs from side to side.
name: CHAIR WINDSHIELD WIPERS

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Breathe regularly.
This exercise warms up your hips and knees.
